title: Special Topics in Journalism; International News Reporting: Foreign Affairs, Safety Concerns, and Audience Diversity
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR201

This course is an introduction to international news reporting. We will discuss 1) U.S. foreign affairs and its potential impact on newsrooms coverage of international topics; 2) stereotypes in covering international news; 3) covering complex issues such as conflicts and immigration; and 4) safety and trauma risks for international reporters.
